[File: project scope.docx]
Detailed project scope, solution architecture, technology stack, and API definitions tailored to the requirements for the Uno Minda AI Hub intranet website.

1. Project Scope & Objectives

Project Name: Uno Minda AI Hub (Phase 1)Timeline: Start Immediately – End by February 28, 2026Primary Goal: Create a centralized, responsive intranet hub to foster AI adoption, showcase internal success stories, and enable employee education

Core Deliverables:

Information Hub: A dynamic repository for AI initiatives, success stories (replicated from plants), use cases, and leadership talks

Knowledge Center: Sections for AI courses, workshops, blogs, newsletters, and tools (e.g., Gamma) to upskill employee

Interactive Engagement:

Idea Capture: Integration with Microsoft Forms to crowdsource AI ideas

Contact Mechanism: A custom form allowing users to send emails without needing an Outlook client

Daily News: Automated feed of external AI news

Content Management System (CMS): A non-technical admin panel (Template-based) for updating content, images, and articles without coding

2. Solution Architecture & Technology Stack

I recommend a Headless CMS Architecture. This decouples the frontend (what users see) from the backend (content management), allowing for a modern, fast UI while giving admins a simple interface to manage content.

Proposed Tech Stack:

Frontend (User Interface): Next.js (React Framework)

Reasoning: Delivers the "Clean, modern look" and "Responsive design" required8888. Excellent performance and supports easy implementation of Dark/Light themes

Backend / CMS: Strapi (Headless CMS) OR Directus

Reasoning: Self-hosted (secure for Intranet), provides the required "Admin panel" and "Templates" out of the box. It automatically generates the APIs needed to fetch data.

Database: PostgreSQL

Reasoning: Robust, enterprise-grade relational database to store user ideas, content, and metadata.

Authentication: LDAP / Active Directory Integration

Reasoning: Since this is an Intranet site11, it should likely integrate with Uno Minda's existing employee login system for security.

Integrations:

Microsoft Graph API: For seamless integration with Microsoft Forms and potential Outlook features.

SMTP Service: For the "Contact Me" email feature.



3. Detailed Features & Functionality

Feature Area

Description & Requirement Mapping

Homepage

Hero section with "Leadership Talks," "Daily AI News Ticker," and featured "AI Initiatives"

Knowledge Base

Dynamic filtering for "Use Cases" (by Department/Plant), "Articles," and "Blogs"

Tools & Resources

A grid layout linking to approved AI tools (Gamma, etc.) and downloadables

Idea Portal

A dedicated page embedding Microsoft Forms or a custom form that sends data to MS Lists/Forms via API15.

Events

Calendar view for "Workshops," "Hackathons," and "Courses"

Contact

Custom form: Input -> Backend -> SMTP -> Email. Includes QR Code display



4. Open API Requirements (Swagger/OpenAPI Spec)

To enable the frontend to display data dynamically, the backend must expose the following RESTful API endpoints.

A. Core Content APIs

GET /api/v1/initiatives

Description: Fetches list of AI projects and success stories.

Response Data: id, title, description, plant_location, impact_metrics, image_url.

GET /api/v1/use-cases

Description: Fetches potential AI use cases for employees to browse.

Filters: department, difficulty_level.

GET /api/v1/news

Description: Fetches daily AI news.

Source: This endpoint will connect to an external aggregator (e.g., NewsAPI.org) and cache results for the Intranet.

GET /api/v1/leadership-talks

Description: Returns video links or article summaries from leadership.

B. Learning & Tools APIs

GET /api/v1/tools

Description: List of recommended tools (e.g., Gamma) with redirection links.

GET /api/v1/courses

Description: List of available internal or external AI courses.

C. Interaction APIs

POST /api/v1/contact

Description: Handles the "Contact Me" functionality.

Payload: { "sender_name": "String", "sender_email": "String", "message": "String", "recipient_group": "String" }

POST /api/v1/ideas

Description: Receives user innovation ideas and posts them to the database or Microsoft Form handler.

Payload: { "employee_id": "String", "idea_title": "String", "description": "String", "category": "String" }



5. Security & Data Protection 

Access Control: Website accessible only within the Uno Minda network (VPN/Intranet).

Sanitization: All input fields (Forms, Search) must be sanitized to prevent XSS/Injection attacks.

Role-Based Access (RBAC): Admin panel access restricted to specific Content Managers only.

[File: website_requirements (1).docx]
Website Development 

Company Name: Uno Minda Project Name: AI Website Date: 9th January 2026



1. Objective

The purpose of this website is to create a centralized hub for Artificial Intelligence where individuals can learn, understand, and effectively use AI in real-world scenarios. This in the phase=1 will be an intranet website.

The platform will enable users to:

Gain insights of the AI Projects @ Uno Minda.

Get detailed list of all AI Related USE Cases that can be worked @ Uno Minda

Use this site to replicate the success stories that has been deployed in the plants.

Enable AI Skill based knowledge resource for the Uno Minda employees.

Links and redirections to the Tools which can help in improving productivity eg: Gamma etc…

API Linkage to the AI News with daily refresh.

Ideas capture from the user to be displayed on the website.



2. Type of Website

Phase-1Intranet based corporate website with Corporate Branding.



3. Key Pages Required

Home

Landing page 

Leadership talks

AI Initiatives  

Ideas 





Insights

Newsletter 

Articles

Blogs 

Tools 

AI for all

Use Cases 

Workshops 

Games 

Hackathon

Courses  

Connect with us 

QR code

Form



4. Key Features Required

Responsive design (mobile & desktop)

Contact / enquiry form/barcode

Contact me for will allow users to send email without opening their outlook.

Pannel to update the Website content using a template rather that directly on the website.

Linkage with Microsoft forms which will capture the ideas of the users.

Admin panel to update content

Market Benchmarking on Security and Data protection. 



5. Design Expectations

Clean, modern look and interactive 

Brand theme to be followed along with Theme adaptation (Dark/White)

Vendor to propose UI ideas



6. Technology Preference

Open to vendor suggestions



7. Content Responsibility

Content Management can be done either by partner or in-house by the Uno Minda team. 

The scope/commercials to be shared for both the use cases.

API Linkages to be done via the API provided by Uno Minda team or suggestion from the Vendors based on the industry benchmarking.



8. Timeline Expectation

Expected project duration: February End

**Uno Minda AI Hub Intranet Website Project Scope and Requirements**

**Project Overview**

The Uno Minda AI Hub is a centralized intranet website aimed at fostering AI adoption, showcasing internal success stories, and enabling employee education. The project will be completed in two phases, with Phase 1 focusing on the development of the intranet website.

**Project Scope**

The project scope includes the following key deliverables:

1. **Information Hub**: A dynamic repository for AI initiatives, success stories, use cases, and leadership talks.
2. **Knowledge Center**: Sections for AI courses, workshops, blogs, newsletters, and tools to upskill employees.
3. **Interactive Engagement**: Idea capture through Microsoft Forms, contact mechanism, and daily news feed.
4. **Content Management System (CMS)**: A non-technical admin panel for updating content, images, and articles without coding.

**Solution Architecture and Technology Stack**

The recommended solution architecture is a Headless CMS Architecture, which decouples the frontend from the backend, allowing for a modern, fast UI and a simple interface for admins to manage content.

The proposed technology stack includes:

1. **Frontend (User Interface)**: Next.js (React Framework)
2. **Backend / CMS**: Strapi (Headless CMS) or Directus
3. **Database**: PostgreSQL
4. **Authentication**: LDAP / Active Directory Integration
5. **Integrations**: Microsoft Graph API, SMTP Service

**Detailed Features and Functionality**

The project includes the following features and functionality:

1. **Homepage**: Hero section with leadership talks, daily AI news ticker, and featured AI initiatives.
2. **Knowledge Base**: Dynamic filtering for use cases, articles, and blogs.
3. **Tools & Resources**: Grid layout linking to approved AI tools and downloadables.
4. **Idea Portal**: Dedicated page for idea capture through Microsoft Forms or a custom form.
5. **Events Calendar**: Calendar view for workshops, hackathons, and courses.
6. **Contact**: Custom form for sending emails without needing an Outlook client.

**Open API Requirements**

The backend must expose the following RESTful API endpoints:

1. **Core Content APIs**: GET /api/v1/initiatives, GET /api/v1/use-cases, GET /api/v1/news, GET /api/v1/leadership-talks
2. **Learning & Tools APIs**: GET /api/v1/tools, GET /api/v1/courses
3. **Interaction APIs**: POST /api/v1/contact, POST /api/v1/ideas

**Security and Data Protection**

The project includes the following security and data protection measures:

1. **Access Control**: Website accessible only within the Uno Minda network (VPN/Intranet).
2. **Sanitization**: All input fields must be sanitized to prevent XSS/Injection attacks.
3. **Role-Based Access (RBAC)**: Admin panel access restricted to specific Content Managers only.

**Timeline and Expectations**

The project is expected to be completed by February 28, 2026. The vendor is expected to propose UI ideas, suggest industry benchmarking for security and data protection, and provide content management options.
